members: python3 -c no argv; reads stdin and CANARY_REPAIR_TOKEN env, replaces token with redacted marker to stdout; used when printing Git/gh failures, no file write

semantics.input: UTF-8 stdin plus inherited nonempty CANARY_REPAIR_TOKEN; no secret argv
semantics.output: Literal nonoverlapping token replacement with ***redacted***, preserving all other input bytes
semantics.malformed: Missing/empty/non-UTF-8 token, malformed stream and input read failure refuse without stdout
semantics.controller: Copy the prepared absolute executable into owned private state before candidate checkout. No fallback/bootstrap or candidate-owned selection.
semantics.lifetime: Private FIFO carries diagnostics in kernel pipe storage, without a raw log file. Explicit reader PID is waited before FIFO/executable cleanup. Successful push is marked before filtering completes so exact-branch rollback remains possible on filter failure.
semantics.policy: Exact ready commit, existing permission/credential scope, publication order, ambiguous create reconciliation and final success boundary retained.

limits: Single publisher inline-interpreter edge replaced. No real credentials, GitHub publication, remote/platform/model or protected rollout qualification.

root_postimage_qualification.limits: Finite actual CLI and publisher fixtures only. Real credentials, publication, hosted/platform/native/model acceptance remain unverified.
